d: A shocking incident has emerged from Samastipur, Bihar, where a four-year-old girl allegedly died after being beaten by her mother for eating prasad prepared for Chhath Puja. According to media reports, the incident took place on November 15 in Mohammadpur Birauli village, under Pusa police station limits. The child's father alleged that his wife, Reena Kumari, became angry after their daughter, Suhani, touched and ate some of the prasad prepared for the festival and allegedly beat her.
